why: v26.1: Chad, 12 Nov 2026: "i dislike the walking sound effect, it does not sound like walking on grass ground, do a better sound effect for it please". Four kinds of grass step, four takes each (eleven_text_to_sound_v2, influence 0.5); C is a short walk of four steps, cut into its steps here.

prompts.x3grassA: Close foley of a single footstep on a natural grass lawn: a soft heel-to-toe press with a gentle swishing crunch of grass blades under the foot, outdoors, close microphone, no reverb.
prompts.x3grassB: One barefoot step on thick summer grass: a soft swish and a quiet crunch of grass blades under the sole, natural outdoor foley, close and dry.
prompts.x3grassC: A person walking slowly across a grass lawn: four natural footsteps, bare feet on short grass, each step a soft swish and light crunch of blades, outdoors on a calm day, close microphone, evenly spaced.
prompts.x3grassD: Footsteps on dry grass: a single step, the foot pressing into short dry grass with a crisp rustling crunch and a soft settle, mid and high frequencies, close foley, no reverb.
